visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person is seen from a high-angle POV holding a green Taiwan passport and a boarding pass while standing on a patterned airport carpet. (2) The camera moves through a bright, white airport jet bridge toward the open cabin door of an airplane. (3) An EVA AIR Boeing 777-300ER sits on the sunny tarmac, surrounded by baggage trailers and airport service vehicles under a bright sky. (4) A young woman with brown hair and a white top smiles at the camera while sitting in the back of a car, holding a purple plush toy with rabbit ears. (5) A static shot shows a white sign with black text indicating queue numbers at the Singapore Indoor Stadium. (6) The young woman talks enthusiastically to the camera in an outdoor setting with palm trees and a light blue sky in the background. (7) The woman walks through a crowded entrance hall with 'PREMIER WEST ENTRANCE' signage hanging from the ceiling. (8) A framed poster of the K-pop group TWICE for their 'Ready to Be' world tour in Singapore is shown on a grey wall. (9) The woman stands in a vast, dark stadium filled with a crowd holding lightsticks, looking directly into the lens with an excited expression. (10) A montage of the K-pop group TWICE performing on a brightly lit stage follows, with members in white, black, and leopard-print outfits dancing and singing amidst intense stage lighting and laser effects. (11) Three members of TWICE pose together on stage, smiling and waving as the camera captures them in a medium full shot.

(2) A cheerful female voice provides high-pitched, excited narration over the music, discussing the trip. (3) A sudden transition to loud, high-arousal screaming and cheering from a large crowd marks the arrival at the concert venue. (4) Multiple female voices are heard singing in Korean and English, with live concert acoustics featuring heavy bass resonance and sharp vocal transients. (5) The music shifts between different K-pop song sections as the editing pace increases, maintaining a bright spectral centroid and high energy levels throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Preparation/Travel -> Venue Arrival -> Climax (Concert Performance).
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a fan's journey from Taiwan to Singapore specifically to attend a TWICE concert. It captures the anticipation of travel and the high-energy highlights of the live performance to share the experience with other fans.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Brand logos like EVA AIR and TWICE appear as part of the narrative of traveling and attending an event, rather than a formal sponsorship.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines personal vlog elements with high-quality concert footage, creating a vibrant documentation of fan culture and international travel for live entertainment.
